remarks: Unique beach club membership in the private Roton Point Club on Long Island Sound. Nestled on 13 acres with panoramic views of Long Island Sound all the way to Manhattan. Roton Point Club is a great location with experiences for everyone including: Summer Camps, Swimming activities, 3 pools, 8 Har-tru Tennis Courts with team play and pro instruction, Waterfront Sailing/Boating with instruction, Hotel Club House, Bath House, Snack bar, Wooded Grove overlooking the Sound for picnics and parties, Social events from Memorial Day to Labor Day. (YOU DO NOT LIVE AT ROTON POINT, YOU OWN A GROUND FLOOR LOCKER NEAR THE POOL).
